title: Kusanagi Nene — Backstage Operator〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I've just thought of something!
Why don't we incorporate dances from around the world into this scene?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Dances from around the world? Why?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It perfectly portrays the character of Prince Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Prince Pegasus acts for the sake of world peace, remember? Featuring dances from around the world would be one way to express that! What do you think of this great idea of mine?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There he goes with his nonsensical talk again...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, that sounds fun!
Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm glad we see eye to eye!
That's decided then! We'll incorporate dances from around the world!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And the other one only wants to do what sounds fun...)

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... I don't mind, but can you be a bit more specific about the exact kind of dances you want to include?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll think about that now!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: So you were just blurting out whatever came to your mind?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Dances from around the world... In that case, folk dances like flamenco and hopak may be good options to consider. The Bharatanatyam may be an interesting addition too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We could change our background music too.
Something like czardas or mazurka would fit nicely.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! That sounds super fun!
Let's try all that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, Emu... Do you know those dances he mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nopes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then why...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How about you, Nene? Do you know them?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I know flamenco and hopak, but not the others...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Bharatanatyam is an Indian classical dance, one of the four major classical dances, in fact.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Czardas and mazurka are musical styles that were popular during the 19th century. They were both used in Coppelia—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Did you just say Coppelia?!
That makes them songs that are just perfect for me! Excellent! We'll use them!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Coppelia, as in, that Coppelia?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Copyleer?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Coppelia is a comic ballet that was created in the 19th century and still beloved by many audiences today.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I'm a little surprised you actually know your stuff. Then show us how the dance goes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? I don't remember the exact moves...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then just move as I tell you to, alright?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Well, I can do that, yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, Emu, go down and watch us from the front of the stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Will do!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First of all, raise both arms.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. Next, draw a semicircle with your left arm as you put your right arm on your waist.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woooow!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Pfft...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Th-This isn't a ballet move...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, move your right hand next to your face, clench your fist, and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Transform into Gutsman!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Correct, Emu.
That was a perfect Gutsman pose.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excuse me?!
What were you trying to make me do, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hehe... People usually...hehe...realize what's going on halfway through, you know. Are you dumb? Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I only followed his instructions because you said you wanted to see the dance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm next! I wanna do it too!
Watch me go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You don't have to! Let's just focus on the script instead! Hey, Nene...I mean, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop sitting there and come back onto the stage already! We need to continue discussing the script.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do the Gutsman pose together, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Forget Gutsman already!
Hurry up and come over!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He wasn't very keen on having a robot around at first, but now he treats not me, but Robo-Nene as an official member of the troupe.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's such a strange fool...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Robo-Nene! Did you hear me?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Once is enough!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yeeeah.
